An '''anticoncussion field generator''' was a type of [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] that generated an [[anticoncussion field]]. The [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Security Authority]] manufactured the [[Rampart-class anticoncussion generator|''Rampart''-class anticoncussion generator]] which was used to protect the [[Stars' End/Legends|Stars' End]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]].<ref name="EGWT" />
